rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for visually looking at or seeing something, and for examining something briefly.

example.english: I can see you at the door.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 dou2 nei5 hai2 mun4 hau2

rows.note: Use 見 for noticing or being able to see someone, often in 見到, and for meeting or seeing an appointment such as a doctor.

example.english: I will see the doctor tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 gin3 ji1 sang1

rows.note: Use 睇吓 when checking something briefly or finding out whether an action or solution will work.

example.english: Let me see if this method works.
example.traditional: 等我睇吓個方法得唔得。
example.jyutping: dang2 ngo5 tai2 haa5 go3 fong1 faat3 dak1 m4 dak1

rows.note: Use this construction when regarding A as B or treating A as B.

example.english: I see him as one of my own.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dong3 keoi5 hai6 zi6 gei2 jan4
